activity: Tend the plants and small garden areas at home, removing a little spent growth and checking soil moisture. I carry the gardening gloves and pruning shears out, then set them down by the kitchen door when finished.
Collect my backpack, knife roll, thermos, and keys, then leave for the restaurant.
Receive the delivery, check what is missing, and walk the kitchen through the shortage while rebuilding the prep list around available ingredients.
Call one trusted supplier, confirm substitutions, and make the final purchasing and prep decisions instead of improvising alone.
Test the redesigned dish and revise the menu components with the cooks, tasting for balance and checking yields as the kitchen moves around me.
Eat a quick staff meal, drink coffee from the thermos, and leave the updated prep notes where the team can see them.
Return to the restaurant, brief the front and back of house on the revised offering, and set up the station for service.
Run dinner service and closing duties, monitoring the replacement dish, adjusting portions, and supporting the staff through the crowded rush.
